subject: Pilot consumption profile & credit extension request
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@nimrobotics.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@nimrobotics.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot consumption profile & credit extension request

Hi Sanjay / Emma — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a few asks so we can size the pilot and provide a concrete credit proposal:

- Current short-term ask: cover pilot activity for 8 weeks (ingest + live inference + nightly batch reprocessing).
- Ballpark monthly token volumes you mentioned: 25M tokens/month steady-state, with periodic batch spikes up to ~180–220M tokens for nightly reprocessing.
- Target economics you flagged: looking for an effective price in the range of $8k–$12k per month budget for inference, with a target unit economics of ~$9–$10 per 1M tokens during the pilot.

Could you confirm the expected split between real-time (low latency) and batch usage? In particular: 
- Real-time (avg request size ~350 tokens) — estimated % of total tokens?
- Batch (heavy reprocessing jobs, >2k tokens / job) — typical frequency and peak window?

I've attached the simple usage worksheet you showed me — if you can drop in one row with the typical batch run size and frequency we'll run the burn-rate calc and propose credits + a short consumption guardrail.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm procurement timing / budget owner so we know when to hand off pricing?
2) Any compliance docs you need from us up front (SOC2, encryption details)? I can attach our standard SOC2 onboarding packet.

If you confirm volumes + answer the two asks, I can get a formal pilot credit proposal over to you tomorrow.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0192
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@nimrobotics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@nimrobotics.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot consumption profile & credit extension request

Karthik — thanks for the recap and for the worksheet. Confirming the numbers from our side (filled more fully in the attached XLSX):

- Steady-state: ~25M tokens/month (mostly inference traffic from field units).
- Nightly batch: typically 10 reprocessing jobs/week, each ~18–22M tokens, total batch throughput ~200M tokens across peaks.
- Real-time vs batch split: roughly 12% real-time / 88% batch during heavy reprocessing periods; average across month is more like 35% real-time / 65% batch.
- Target pilot budget we can allocate: $9k–$11k / month. We are trying to target ~ $9–$10 / 1M tokens for blended pilot pricing.

Procurement: contract owner is Emma Li (cc'd). We can get internal approval for a 60–90 day pilot if the credit cap is sufficient to cover the expected batch window.

Compliance: please send SOC2 and the network isolation/KMS notes. We will also need a short SOW to kick off with dates (proposed start: 2026-08-17).

Thanks — Sanjay

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@nimrobotics.com>, Emma Li <emma.li@nimrobotics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot consumption profile & credit extension request

Hi Sanjay / Emma — looping in to confirm internal sign-off on a pilot credit package and to clarify economics.

Short notes: 
- We see the usage profile you described as a good candidate for a hybrid pilot (reserved capacity for nightly batch windows + on-demand during real-time).
- For the pilot we can offer a blended unit credit that maps to your target ~$9–$10 per 1M tokens to keep the trial representative of production economics. That will be applied to on-demand consumption with a carve-out for scheduled batch reserved windows (we'll propose reserved pricing for predictable nightly runs if you want lower sustained unit cost).
- We can approve an initial trial credit pool of $15,000 with a 60-day extension option (review at day 45 based on burn rate). If the burn pattern is largely batch-heavy and exceeds the initial guardrails, we'll engage to propose a short-term reserved plan to cap unit cost.

Next steps we need from you: proposed POC start date (you flagged 8/17), and confirmation that Emma is the procurement lead. Once confirmed we'll generate the SOW + trial credit approval PDF and send a DocuSign for signatures.

Best — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.ai
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@nimrobotics.com>

Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@nimrobotics.com>
Date: 2026-08-07T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot consumption profile & credit extension request

Grace / Karthik — thanks, that plan sounds reasonable and aligns with our internal goals. Confirming:

- POC start: 2026-08-17 (we'll hand off infra changes to field ops on 8/12).
- Procurement lead: Emma Li.
- We accept the $15,000 initial trial credit with 60-day window and the day-45 burn-rate review.

Action items for you: please send the SOW + trial credit approval PDF and DocuSign link. Also please attach SOC2 onboarding packet so our security team can start the review (SOC2_onboarding.pdf).

I'll loop procurement once we have the DocuSign link. Looking forward to getting started.

Thanks — Sanjay
